subject.title: fix(reply): prevent hung pre-delivery hooks from blocking lanes

question: Should the shipped reply-runtime Plugin SDK adopt a 15-second default per-stage deadline with fail-open delivery, while allowing plugin owners to declare a longer positive finite budget?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but this intentionally changes existing slow-callback behavior and requires ownership of the compatibility-versus-availability tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt bounded fail-open callbacks
options.body: Land the 15-second per-stage default with explicit longer budgets as the supported compatibility escape hatch.

options.title: Require live channel proof first
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers reproduce the original failure and timeout behavior on a real channel.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded fail-open callbacks
recommendation.body: Land the 15-second per-stage default with explicit longer budgets as the supported compatibility escape hatch.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows the strongest ownership of the dispatcher lifecycle and recent Plugin SDK surface policy.
